name: ATPase H+ transporting accessory protein 1

function.text: ATP6AP1 encodes v-type proton ATPase subunit S1. Annotated molecular activities include small GTPase binding. It participates in osteoclast development and vacuolar acidification.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to congenital disorder of glycosylation type II (x-linked); immunodeficiency 47 (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
